response.description: In November 2025, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL: View, modify, insert rows in a table without manually writing T-SQL code using the interactive Edit Data interface in the MSSQL extension for Visual Studio Code. Learn more. Import and export DACPACs—now available in the MSSQL extension. Apply DACPAC files to new or existing databases or generate new files from existing databases. Learn more.
response.title: Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for November 2025
